reglementIntro: Welcome to the server! Before you start your adventure, please take a moment to read the following rules.

exemple.respectIntro: Eco is first and foremost a community and cooperative adventure.
exemple.respectR1: Respect other players and the staff.
exemple.respectR2: Insults, harassment and toxic behaviour are not tolerated.
exemple.respectR3: Favour communication and mutual help: asking a question often avoids a conflict.
exemple.respectR4: Respect other players’ work, buildings and resources.
exemple.environnementIntro: Your actions have lasting consequences on the ecosystem.
exemple.environnementR1: Avoid overexploiting resources: replant what you cut down.
exemple.environnementR2: Do not deliberately try to wipe out a species.
exemple.environnementR3: Limit air, water and soil pollution.
exemple.environnementAlerte: Deliberate destruction of the ecosystem may lead to staff intervention.
exemple.loisIntro: In Eco, players write the laws and elect their representatives.
exemple.loisR1: Respect the laws voted by the community, even those you did not support.
exemple.loisR2: Put your ideas forward through the proper channels (proposals, votes, elections) rather than forcing them.
exemple.bugsIntro: Software, exploits or bugs that give an unfair advantage are forbidden.
exemple.bugsR1: If you discover a significant problem, let the staff know.
exemple.objectifIntro: A meteor threatens the planet: work together to destroy it in time.
